typical_window.note_en: Ashadha Shukla Dwitiya; shifts with lunar calendar

description.en: Jagannath, Balabhadra and Subhadra ride giant wooden chariots pulled by lakhs of devotees along Puri's Bada Danda — one of the world's largest religious processions.
description.hi: जगन्नाथ, बलभद्र और सुभद्रा की विशाल रथ यात्रा — विश्व के सबसे बड़े धार्मिक जुलूसों में से एक।
description.or: ଜଗନ୍ନାଥ, ବଳଭଦ୍ର ଓ ସୁଭଦ୍ରାଙ୍କ ବିଶାଳ ରଥଯାତ୍ରା — ବିଶ୍ୱର ସବୁଠାରୁ ବଡ଼ ଧାର୍ମିକ ଶୋଭାଯାତ୍ରା ମଧ୍ୟରୁ ଅନ୍ୟତମ।

travel_tips.en: Book Puri hotels 2–3 months ahead; Bada Danda closes to vehicles; try Mahaprasad at Ananda Bazar.

typical_window.note_en: Ashwin Shukla Paksha; shifts with lunar calendar

description.en: Cuttack's centuries-old Durga Puja is famous for its Chandi Medha — massive silver backdrops behind emerald-crowned Durga idols across the old city.
description.hi: कटक की दुर्गा पूजा अपनी चाँदी की चंडी मेढ़ा (silver tableaux) के लिए प्रसिद्ध है।
description.or: କଟକର ଦୁର୍ଗାପୂଜା ତାହାର ପ୍ରସିଦ୍ଧ ଚାନ୍ଦୀ ମେଢ଼ା ପାଇଁ ଜଣାଶୁଣା।

travel_tips.en: Pandal-hopping is best on foot; stay in Cuttack city; visit after 7 PM for the lighting.

description.en: One of Asia's largest open fairs on the Mahanadi banks, commemorating Odia maritime traders who sailed to Bali — boita floating, craft bazaars, food streets.
description.hi: महानदी किनारे ओडिशा के समुद्री व्यापारिक इतिहास की स्मृति में आयोजित विशाल मेला।
description.or: ଓଡ଼ିଆ ସାମୁଦ୍ରିକ ବାଣିଜ୍ୟ ସ୍ମୃତିରେ ମହାନଦୀ କୂଳରେ ହେଉଥିବା ବିଶାଳ ମେଳା।

travel_tips.en: Go on day 1 for Boita Bandana at dawn; evenings are extremely crowded.

description.en: Classical Odissi, Bharatanatyam and other Indian dance forms performed against the floodlit Sun Temple, organised by OTDC every December.
description.hi: सूर्य मंदिर के सामने ओडिसी और अन्य शास्त्रीय नृत्यों का वार्षिक उत्सव।
description.or: ସୂର୍ଯ୍ୟ ମନ୍ଦିର ପୃଷ୍ଠପଟରେ ଓଡ଼ିଶୀ ଓ ଅନ୍ୟାନ୍ୟ ଶାସ୍ତ୍ରୀୟ ନୃତ୍ୟର ଉତ୍ସବ।

travel_tips.en: Book Konark/Puri stays early; carry a shawl — December nights are cool; combine with Chandrabhaga beach sunrise.

description.en: Odissi recitals in the courtyard of the exquisite 10th-century Mukteswar Temple around Makar Sankranti.
description.hi: 10वीं शताब्दी के मुक्तेश्वर मंदिर में ओडिसी नृत्य।

travel_tips.en: Free/low-cost entry; combine with the Ekamra Heritage Walks in Old Town Bhubaneswar.

description.en: Three evenings of Hindustani and Carnatic music at the sculptural Rajarani Temple.
description.hi: राजाराणी मंदिर में शास्त्रीय संगीत की तीन शामें।

travel_tips.en: Check exact dates with OTDC each January.

description.en: The world's largest open-air theatre: Bargarh town becomes mythical Mathura and the Krishna story plays out across streets, ponds and the Jeera river for ~11 days.
description.hi: दुनिया का सबसे बड़ा ओपन-एयर थिएटर — बरगढ़ शहर मथुरा बन जाता है।
description.or: ବିଶ୍ୱର ସବୁଠାରୁ ବଡ଼ ଖୋଲା ରଙ୍ଗମଞ୍ଚ — ବରଗଡ଼ ସହର ମଥୁରା ପରି ହୋଇଯାଏ।

travel_tips.en: Stay in Bargarh town; the Kansa darbar scenes draw the biggest crowds; entire town performs.

description.en: A three-day celebration of womanhood and the earth's annual 'menstruation' — swings on banyan branches, pithas, and a ban on ploughing; unmistakably Odia.
description.hi: स्त्रीत्व और धरती के 'रजस्वला' होने का तीन दिवसीय उत्सव — झूला, पिठे और खेती पर रोक।
description.or: ଝିଅମାନଙ୍କ ଓ ଧରିତ୍ରୀଙ୍କ ରଜସ୍ୱଳା ପାଳନ — ଡଲି, ପିଠା ଓ ହଳ ବନ୍ଦ।

travel_tips.en: Try Raja pithas like podapitha; statewide celebration, best experienced in villages and old town areas.

description.en: Autumn full-moon festival: unmarried girls worship the moon at dawn and dusk with folk songs; Lakshmi Puja follows.
description.hi: शरद पूर्णिमा पर कुमार कन्याओं द्वारा चंद्र पूजा; इसके बाद लक्ष्मी पूजा।
description.or: ଶରଦ ପୁଣିମାରେ କୁମାରୀ ଝିଅମାନଙ୍କ ଚନ୍ଦ୍ର ପୂଜା; ପରେ ଲକ୍ଷ୍ମୀ ପୂଜା।

travel_tips.en: Enjoy Kumar Purnima folk songs; statewide.

typical_window.note_en: Bhadrapada Shukla Panchami; day after Ganesh Chaturthi

description.en: Western Odisha's harvest homecoming — the season's first grains are offered to the deity, followed by 'Nuakhai Juhar' greetings and family feasts.
description.hi: पश्चिमी ओडिशा का फसल उत्सव — 'नुआखाई जुहार' की बधाई और पारिवारिक भोज।
description.or: ପଶ୍ଚିମ ଓଡ଼ିଶାର ନୂଆଧାନ ପର୍ବ — 'ନୂଆଖାଇ ଜୁହାର' ଓ ପାରିବାରିକ ଭୋଜ।

travel_tips.en: Great time to see Sambalpuri folk dance; western Odisha is a different world from the coast.

description.en: Lakhs of pilgrims bathe at dawn at Chandrabhaga beach near Konark in honour of the Sun god.
description.hi: सूर्य देवता के सम्मान में चंद्रभागा समुद्र तट पर प्रभात स्नान।
description.or: ସୂର୍ଯ୍ୟ ଦେବତାଙ୍କ ସମ୍ମାନରେ ଚନ୍ଦ୍ରଭାଗା ବେଳାଭୂମିରେ ପ୍ରାତସ୍ନାନ।

travel_tips.en: Reach the beach by 4:30 AM for the sunrise bath; dress warm.

description.en: Sambalpur's grand 'wedding of Shiva' — the divine marriage of Shiva and Parvati re-enacted with decorated chariots, dance troupes and all-night processions.
description.hi: शिव-पार्वती के दिव्य विवाह का भव्य जुलूस — संबलपुर का प्रसिद्ध उत्सव।
description.or: ଶିବ-ପାର୍ବତୀଙ୍କ ଦିବ୍ୟ ବିବାହର ଭବ୍ୟ ଶୋଭାଯାତ୍ରା — ସାମ୍ବଲପୁରର ପ୍ରସିଦ୍ଧ ପର୍ବ।

travel_tips.en: The night procession is the highlight; book early, hotels fill up.

description.en: Night-long Chhau dance — a UNESCO-listed martial dance form — performed during Chaitra Parva in Baripada, with the royal family's patronage tradition.
description.hi: यूनेस्को-सूचीबद्ध छऊ नृत्य — बरीपदा में रातभर का मंच।
description.or: ୟୁନେସ୍କୋ ସ୍ୱୀକୃତ ଛଉ ନୃତ୍ୟ — ବାରିପଦାରେ ରାତିରେ ପରିବେଷଣ।

travel_tips.en: Baripada is the gateway to Similipal Tiger Reserve — combine both.

description.en: Martial arts and dance festival at the Dhauli Shanti Stupa — on the battlefield where Emperor Ashoka renounced war after the Kalinga war.
description.hi: धौलि शांति स्तूप पर मार्शल आर्ट और नृत्य महोत्सव — कलिंग युद्ध के स्थल पर।
description.or: ଧଉଳି ଶାନ୍ତି ସ୍ତୂପ ନିକଟରେ ମାର୍ଶାଲ ଆର୍ଟ ଓ ନୃତ୍ୟ ଉତ୍ସବ।

travel_tips.en: Pairs beautifully with a Dhauli Peace Pagoda visit; sunset performances.

description.en: One of Odisha's oldest fairs at the twin-goddess Taratarini hill shrine on the Rushikulya river, near Berhampur.
description.hi: ऋषिकुल्या नदी किनारे तारातारिणी हिल श्राइन पर ओडिशा का प्राचीन मेला।
description.or: ଋଷିକୁଲ୍ୟା ନଦୀ କୂଳରେ ତାରତାରିଣୀ ପୀଠର ପ୍ରାଚୀନ ମେଳା।

travel_tips.en: Ropeway to the hilltop shrine; Chaitra Tuesdays are peak days.

description.en: Koraput's district festival of tribal heritage — Desia and Gadaba dance, music, handicrafts, set among the Eastern Ghats.
description.hi: कोरापुट का आदिवासी सांस्कृतिक महोत्सव — नृत्य, संगीत और हस्तशिल्प।
description.or: କୋରାପୁଟର ଆଦିବାସୀ ସାଂସ୍କୃତିକ ମହୋତ୍ସବ — ନୃତ୍ୟ, ସଙ୍ଗୀତ ଓ ହସ୍ତଶିଳ୍ପ।

travel_tips.en: Combine with Duduma waterfall and Deomali peak; cool nights.

description.en: Annual congregation of Mahima ascetics — India's unique monotheistic 'Alekh' order — offering ghee to the eternal flame.
description.hi: महिमा धर्म के साधुओं का वार्षिक समागम — अनोखा एकेश्वरवादी संप्रदाय।

travel_tips.en: Respect the ascetics' silence rules; pair with Kapilash temple nearby.
